svg.title: deepen
svg.desc: A terminal drawing of four axes of ambition: altitude, range, speed and depth. Below the task's layer, four narrower but more detailed planes mark the questions: what a top pro would do, the rawest material, the instruments they use, an outside judge. The depth axis lands on the word deepen. On the right, the 12-line prompt you get back.

text.tspan: what a top pro would do

g.text: · how a field-leading expert would do it
axes after Felix Rieseberg · “How to be more ambitious”
4 levels · each narrower, more detailed · deeper, not bigger
